propositions: rebar review-code allows authors to preview code-review findings locally before pushing, matching rebar review-plan for plan review, but the local code-review self-check is not discoverable in the same places as plan review's local self-check
the author on-ramp guide passing-code-review.md does not mention rebar review-code or explain how to enable local code review preview
the docs index and AGENTS.md pointer do not name rebar review-code as the local preview mechanism for code review
the loop diagram in passing-code-review.md does not show the optional local rebar review-code preview step
authors can discover rebar review-plan as a local self-check but cannot discover the equivalent rebar review-code for code review, creating an asymmetry in gate discoverability
